_meta.title: 1 Corinthians — key verses per chapter (King James Version, public domain)
_meta.description: Several curated key verses from each of the 16 chapters of 1 Corinthians. Ecosystem-generic 864zeros content. Each record carries the exact scripture plus an original plain-English rendering.
_meta.license: Public domain (KJV scripture); 'plain' renderings are original 864zeros writing
_meta.source: getbible.net v2 (KJV, book 46 1 Corinthians); verses verbatim, curly apostrophes normalized to straight
_meta.selection: several key verses per chapter (~1-5, scaled to chapter substance)
_meta.keying: book + chapter + citation; multiple records per chapter
_meta.renderings: text = the exact KJV verse; plain = original 864zeros plain-English 2026 rendering, faithful to the verse's meaning (~grade 6-8), authored not quoted. KJV 'charity' rendered 'love' in plain.
_meta.note: KJV New Testament renders the divine name as 'Lord'/'God' (no tetragrammaton); text is verbatim KJV. No review gate — author is reviewer.

verses.text: For the preaching of the cross is to them that perish foolishness; but unto us which are saved it is the power of God.
verses.plain: The message of the cross sounds foolish to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it's the power of God.

verses.text: But God hath chosen the foolish things of the world to confound the wise; and God hath chosen the weak things of the world to confound the things which are mighty;
verses.plain: But God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise, and the weak things of the world to shame the strong.

verses.text: That, according as it is written, He that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.
verses.plain: so that, as it's written, 'Let the one who boasts boast in the Lord.'

verses.text: For I determined not to know any thing among you, save Jesus Christ, and him crucified.
verses.plain: For I made up my mind to know nothing among you except Jesus Christ and him crucified.

verses.text: But as it is written, Eye hath not seen, nor ear heard, neither have entered into the heart of man, the things which God hath prepared for them that love him.
verses.plain: But as it's written: 'No eye has seen, no ear has heard, no mind has imagined the things God has prepared for those who love him.'

verses.text: For other foundation can no man lay than that is laid, which is Jesus Christ.
verses.plain: For no one can lay any foundation other than the one already laid, which is Jesus Christ.

verses.text: Know ye not that ye are the temple of God, and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you?
verses.plain: Don't you know that you are God's temple, and that God's Spirit lives in you?

verses.text: Moreover it is required in stewards, that a man be found faithful.
verses.plain: Now it's required of those given a trust that they prove faithful.

verses.text: Purge out therefore the old leaven, that ye may be a new lump, as ye are unleavened. For even Christ our passover is sacrificed for us:
verses.plain: Get rid of the old yeast so you can be a fresh batch, since Christ our Passover lamb has been sacrificed for us.

verses.text: What? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost which is in you, which ye have of God, and ye are not your own?
verses.plain: Don't you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit, who is in you, whom you received from God? You are not your own.

verses.text: For ye are bought with a price: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God's.
verses.plain: You were bought at a price. So honor God with your body and your spirit, which belong to him.

verses.text: Ye are bought with a price; be not ye the servants of men.
verses.plain: You were bought at a price; don't become slaves to people.

verses.text: Now as touching things offered unto idols, we know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffeth up, but charity edifieth.
verses.plain: Knowledge puffs a person up, but love builds people up.

verses.text: But to us there is but one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we in him; and one Lord Jesus Christ, by whom are all things, and we by him.
verses.plain: yet for us there is one God, the Father, from whom all things came and for whom we live; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom all things came and through whom we live.

verses.text: Know ye not that they which run in a race run all, but one receiveth the prize? So run, that ye may obtain.
verses.plain: Don't you know that in a race all the runners run, but only one gets the prize? So run in a way that wins it.

verses.text: And every man that striveth for the mastery is temperate in all things. Now they do it to obtain a corruptible crown; but we an incorruptible.
verses.plain: Everyone who competes trains with strict discipline. They do it for a crown that won't last, but we do it for one that lasts forever.

verses.text: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.
verses.plain: No temptation has come to you that isn't common to everyone. And God is faithful — he won't let you be tempted beyond what you can bear, but with the temptation he'll also give you a way out, so you can stand up under it.

verses.text: Whether therefore ye eat, or drink, or whatsoever ye do, do all to the glory of God.
verses.plain: So whether you eat or drink or whatever you do, do it all for the glory of God.

verses.text: Be ye followers of me, even as I also am of Christ.
verses.plain: Follow my example, as I follow the example of Christ.

verses.text: But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal.
verses.plain: To each person the Spirit is given for the good of all.

verses.text: Now ye are the body of Christ, and members in particular.
verses.plain: Now you are the body of Christ, and each of you is a part of it.

verses.text: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.
verses.plain: If I speak in the tongues of men and of angels but don't have love, I'm only a noisy gong or a clanging cymbal.

verses.text: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,
verses.plain: Love is patient, love is kind. It doesn't envy, it doesn't boast, it isn't proud.

verses.text: Beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.
verses.plain: It always protects, always trusts, always hopes, always perseveres.

verses.text: Charity never faileth: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.
verses.plain: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will end; where there are tongues, they will be stilled; where there is knowledge, it will pass away.

verses.text: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.
verses.plain: And now these three remain: faith, hope, and love. But the greatest of these is love.

verses.text: For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.
verses.plain: For God is not a God of confusion but of peace.

verses.text: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures;
verses.plain: For what I received I passed on to you as most important: that Christ died for our sins, just as the scriptures said,

verses.text: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.plain: But thanks be to God! He gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.text: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.
verses.plain: So, my dear brothers and sisters, stand firm. Let nothing move you. Always give yourselves fully to the work of the Lord, because you know that your labor in the Lord is not in vain.

verses.text: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.
verses.plain: Be on your guard; stand firm in the faith; be courageous; be strong.

verses.text: Let all your things be done with charity.
verses.plain: Do everything in love.
